title: How I built this
description: Wesson created original cover art portraits for How I Built This, the acclaimed podcast celebrating the stories behind the world's most iconic companies and entrepreneurs. Each illustration captures the energy and vision of the founders at the heart of the show.

title: John Templeton Prize
description: Since 2022, Wesson has created official portrait illustrations for the Templeton Prize - one of the world's most prestigious honors for those exploring the intersections of science, spirit, and human existence. Four laureates. Four portraits. Frank Wilczek, Pumla Gobodo-Madikizela, Edna Adan Ismail, and Simon Conway Morris. Each commission asked the same quiet question: beyond the accolades, who is this person? That's the work Wesson loves most.

title: AADL Mural
description: Wesson was selected as a contributing artist for the Black Bicentennial Mural Project, part of Ann Arbor's 200th anniversary celebration. The project brings together artists to tell the stories and uncover the histories that matter to the people living through this milestone moment - centering Black experience within a city's living memory.

title: Editorial
description: Wesson has contributed editorial illustrations to Outlier Media, Detroit's nonprofit newsroom dedicated to local accountability and community information. His work brings visual dimension to stories that matter to Detroiters - grounding the reporting in the same city he calls home.

title: Sketchbook
description: My Sketchbook is a running record of faces and feelings - portraits of musicians caught in the moment, rendered with the loose instinct of a practiced eye.

title: Music Stuff
description: Is an ongoing portrait series celebrating the faces of hip-hop - from Kendrick Lamar to Rick Ross to Drake - rendered with bold line and raw instinct. Each sketch is a study in presence, capturing the artists who shape the culture as much as the music.
